shared_context: Three participants need to choose an exercise schedule to prepare for a 5-day hiking holiday in moderate mountain terrain. The schedule should build endurance, strength, and flexibility over 8 weeks with 3 sessions per week.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a 29-year-old outdoor enthusiast who enjoys combining gym workouts with hiking.
personas.private_goal: To build both hiking endurance and muscle strength efficiently before the trip.

A.reason_for: Combines real hiking practice with strength training, matching my goal to improve endurance and core stability.

B.reason_for: Improves flexibility and cardiovascular fitness indoors, so weather is not a problem.
B.reason_against: Less specific to hiking endurance and lacks outdoor exposure.

C.reason_for: Simulates actual hiking conditions with load carrying, which is very relevant.
C.reason_against: Sessions are long and might be tiring, requiring suitable terrain.

D.reason_for: Varied exercises improve overall fitness and reduce monotony.
D.reason_against: Less direct hiking practice and might not fully prepare for mountain terrain.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a 35-year-old office worker who prefers indoor workouts and values convenience.
personas.private_goal: To improve cardiovascular fitness and flexibility without relying on outdoor conditions.

A.reason_for: Good combination of endurance and strength training.
A.reason_against: Needs gym and outdoor access, which can be inconvenient for me.

B.reason_for: Can be done indoors regardless of weather and improves flexibility and joint mobility.

C.reason_against: Long sessions are tiring and require suitable terrain I may not have easy access to.

D.reason_for: Varied exercises improve overall fitness and flexibility indoors.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a 42-year-old fitness coach who enjoys a mix of activities to maintain overall health.
personas.private_goal: To prepare comprehensively with varied exercises that build strength, flexibility, and endurance.

A.reason_for: Combines outdoor hiking and strength training which is effective for preparation.
A.reason_against: Requires gym access which might limit flexibility.

B.reason_for: Improves cardiovascular fitness and flexibility indoors.
B.reason_against: Less specific to hiking endurance and outdoor conditions.

C.reason_for: Simulates actual hiking with weighted backpack.
C.reason_against: Long sessions may be tiring and terrain dependent.

D.reason_for: Varied cross-training reduces monotony and improves multiple fitness areas, aligning with my holistic approach.
